title: SR 62 over Tekoppel Avenue
source_note: 2023 public-hearing preliminary design; general arrangement extract
assumptions: This is not a full detail drawing set. Girder, bearing, abutment and MSE wall information is needed to reconstruct exterior components. NBI matching uses the existing bridge location.
Internal reinforcing bars, tendons and embedded hardware are excluded. Fabrication details absent from the drawings are not claimed as reconstructed.
Colors distinguish components. Individual volumes may overlap at assembly boundaries and must not be summed as a quantity takeoff.
Vertical datum EL 375 ft; origin station 34668.00. Local X follows the road longitudinal axis and does not represent geographic north.
Left skew is applied by transforming end lines with tan(skew). Girders are straight precast members; variable haunches fill the difference from the vertical road profile.
The cross-section's 2% slopes and two-way crown are applied. Crown locations are approximated at roadway centers because exact offsets are unavailable.
The 42 in FT railing height, bulb-tee web, bottom flange and corners, retaining wall thickness and abutment depth are assumptions based on general drawings, not detailed design dimensions.

detail_coverage.feature: Spans, width, skew and vertical alignment
detail_coverage.detail: Single span 79.5 ft; deck 81.5 by 103 ft; left skew 0 degrees. The source vertical curve is applied.
Includes 11 girders with nominal 36 by 61 in sections and drawing spacing, a 8 in slab and 2 pour regions. Detailed girder profiles and haunches are approximate.
Includes integral abutments, MSE front envelopes and approach slabs. Retaining wall panels, rear faces, piles and footing fabrication details are not modeled.
Includes FT outer railings and a 2 ft 6 in central concrete barrier. Unspecified heights and fabrication sections are approximate.

Internal reinforcement, tendons, piles, rear retaining structures, underlying roads/railways, bank protection, terrain and fabrication hardware are excluded. This model uses a 6-page general arrangement extract and is not a detailed design model.

coordinate_system.native: X longitudinal / Y transverse / Z up; metres. Local datum described in assumptions.
